message.content:
Based on the screenshot provided, here is the evaluation of the route editor panel:

1.  **Clipping/Truncation/Overlapping:** **Yes, there is a defect.** The "Enable road snapping..." button at the top is **truncated** (clipped by the container edge), cutting off the end of the text. The rest of the text (descriptions, buttons, point rows) appears fully visible and non-overlapping.
2.  **Checkbox Alignment:** **Yes, they are aligned.** The checkboxes in the point rows are vertically aligned with the orange number badges and the coordinate text columns.
3.  **Select/Clear Row:** **Yes, it is a clean row.** The "4 of 12 points selected" text, "Select all" pill, and "Clear" pill are all positioned on the same horizontal line with consistent spacing.
4.  **'Repeat a loop' Card Spacing:** **Yes, it is well-spaced and readable.** The title, hint text, action buttons, and status line have clear vertical separation. The layout is logical and easy to read.
